method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; a seat-neutral core (lta-core.l4, taa-procedure.l4, with shared nouns in lta-common.l4) holding 5 regulative rules (7 DEONTIC definitions, counting the two branches of TAA Part 10), and a seat layer (lta-seat.l4, 43 exported questions) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (a year before 2020/2021, a year with no thresholds supplied, thresholds out of order, or a separate assessment without its s 9(8) deduction, answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Land Tax Act 1936 (SA): the Open Australian Legal Corpus text as at 2023-07-01 (version_id south_australian_legislation:2023-07-01/1936.2318.un, scraped 2024-09-13), deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/land-tax-act-1936.txt; NOT the official text, and out of date (the Current Titles list of 22 September 2026 shows version 4.12.2025). Brought in: Taxation Administration Act 1996 (SA), corpus text as at 2019-10-03 (version_id south_australian_legislation:2019-10-03/1996.80.un, scraped 2024-09-13), deposited at ../../../taxation-administration-act-1996/registers/source-bundle/taxation-administration-act-1996.txt; also listed at 4.12.2025. The s 8A(2a), (3), (3b) and s 9(8) formulas are missing from the deposit: thresholds and the s 9(8) deduction are INPUTS. Amounts the text states are used: 2020/21 A $450 000 and D $1 350 000; D $1 350 000 for 2021/22 and $2 000 000 for 2022/23. Every year's thresholds, and any rate change after 2023-07-01 (from 2024/25), are inputs; the TAA market rate is an input.

checks.result: 248 assertions written, 248 satisfied (135 core, 40 TAA, 73 seat), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 6 #TRACEs with an expect line (4 breaches, 2 obligations pending), each read and as expected; a control copy with one expected value altered failed as it should

scope: From the seat of the individual owner of land (the home owner, and the individual who owns other land). Land Tax Act: s 2 (owner, capacities, residential land exemption); s 4(1)(n), (2), (3); s 5(1), (2), (4), (6)-(9) (s 5(7) regulative: notify an error in the exemption notice within 21 days), (10)(a), (ab), (ac), (ad), (b), (ba), (bb), (e), (f), (h), (10a) (12 months' occupation after completion, no rent), (10b), (10c), (11a), (12) (partial exemption scale), (12a), (13); s 5AA; s 5A; s 6; s 7 (site value an input); s 8A(1), (2), (3a), (7), (8) (thresholds inputs; stated amounts used; rounding); Schedule 1 Part 1 and Part 2 clauses 2 and 3 as tables over thresholds A-D with LT (TB), LT (TC), LT (TD); s 8B; s 9(1), (2), (4), (6), (8) (deduction an input), (9); ss 14-17; s 19(1) (regulative: pay within 30 days after service; also run with TAA s 91), s 19(2), (3). Taxation Administration Act: ss 25-27 (market rate an input), 30-32, 33 (regulative), 84, 86 (objection within 60 days), 87, 91, 92, 93, 94 (appeal within 60 days, or on 14 days' notice after 90 undetermined days), 95; Part 10 regulative. Out: trusts (ss 11-13F, Schedule 1 Part 3, s 13D) except the special disability trust; related corporations (ss 13G-13J); build-to-rent (s 7A); strata and community plans (s 10); primary production and other non-residential exemptions (s 4(1) other than (n); s 5(10)(c), (ca), (cb), (d), (g)); enforcement (ss 18, 20-24); ss 25, 26; TAA machinery, interest on refunds (ss 90, 99), remission (ss 29, 34), s 102.

regulative_rules_list: s 5(7) -- notify the Commissioner of an error in the exemption notice within 21 days
s 19(1) -- pay the land tax within 30 days after service of the assessment
s 19(1) with TAA s 91 -- pay within 30 days even while objecting
TAA s 33 -- pay the penalty tax within the period specified in the assessment
TAA Part 10 -- object within 60 days, then appeal within 60 days of the determination (ss 86, 89, 92, 94)
